title: The AI Assistant's history keeps a member's name and typed mobile number for 400 days, out of reach of any member erase
what: Every AI Assistant request is saved with the owner's own words, as typed (mobile numbers and emails are hidden only from the AI, not from this saved copy), and with the drafted change, which can hold a new member's name, mobile number and amount. This copy stays 400 days and is shown again in the assistant's history and credits list. If a member asks the gym to erase them, nothing reaches this copy: it is deleted only when its 400 days are up or the whole gym is deleted. In the test gym 2 of 11 saved requests hold member details.
expected: When a member is erased, their name and number are also cleared from the AI Assistant's saved requests, or the saved copy keeps the hidden form of numbers.
who: members whose details the owner types into the AI Assistant
how_often: every member erase request, once erasing a member exists
fix_line: Include the AI Assistant's saved requests in the member erase, or save them with numbers already hidden

title: The record of who asked the AI is deleted after 400 days only by chance
what: Each AI question is recorded with who asked (a staff or member id, or a coded visitor address) to count credits. Records older than 400 days are deleted only when a new question happens to trigger it (about 1 in 100 questions). The nightly clean-up deletes old AI requests but skips these records. If questions slow or stop, old records stay past 400 days. The privacy notice names the 400 days for requests but says nothing about this record of who asked.
expected: These records are deleted every night once they are 400 days old, like the AI requests, and the notice names them.
who: members, staff and gym page visitors who ask the AI
fix_line: Add these records to the nightly 400-day clean-up and mention them in the privacy notice

items.reason: 10 promises checked. Kept: owner and staff questions are free and only day-limited (0083 is live in the catalog), so 'Questions never use credits', 'This never uses credits' and 'No more free questions today' hold for the owner; writing a plan and the Hindi words take no credit (credits only on Send or Save); monthly free credits (50 or 100 for paid yearly or lifetime, none on monthly or trial) and 'used first' match the server; 'English only unless you try again' matches the failed-Hindi path. Broken: 'A task uses credits only when you send or save it' shows while members' AI answers also take the gym's credits (reused FN-A3-website-1-03).

Notice: the English notice describes the assistant; the Hindi half does not (reused). Purpose: the AI gets the masked sentence and a small context (gym, plans, batches, trainer first names), no member records. Deletion: AI history is outside any member erase (01); the question record is deleted only by chance (02). Gym delete cascades both tables. Breach timing and children: nothing of that kind in this area.

Only the owner key reads AI requests and question counts; the tables have no grants. HQ sees only counts and credit totals for a gym, no request words, so no read log is needed. No HQ or worker code reads the tables directly.
AI requests: 400 days, deleted on each save for that gym and every night for all gyms (oldest test-gym request is 13 Nov 2026). The record of who asked has no nightly delete (02).

Typed requests: phones and emails masked in the browser and again on the server (13+ digit card numbers too), matching the notice; plan focus masked; rewrite words masked on the server. Spoken requests: the clip can go to Sarvam, which the notice never names (reused). Hindi notice omits the assistant's companies (reused). No analytics or WhatsApp sends from this area.

Gym delete removes both tables (on delete cascade); backups expire on the general backup clock. A member erase does not reach the AI requests that name them (01). A real delete was not run (live write).
